name: cf-worker-http-to-wg-public-bridge
_retired: 2026-06-23: superseded by c3-public-api (/pub) + http-to-smtp-proxy-api. Disabled so the derive drops it from probe targets; kept for history.
description: HTTP-to-SMTP bridge on oci-analytics (the public-ingress VM in the wg-public mesh). CF Worker POSTs JSON email payloads to this container; container speaks SMTP over wg-public to maddy:25 + stalwart:2025 on oci-mail. Public path: api.diegonmarcos.com/cf-worker-bridge/. Mirrors aa-sui_tools-http-to-smtp-proxy-api shape but binds on the wg-public hub IP (10.1.0.1) and forwards over wg-public.

api.description: POST raw RFC 5322 email body. Translates to SMTP and dual-delivers to maddy:25 + Stalwart:2025 over wg-public mesh. Used by CF email-forwarder Worker for inbound mail when oci-analytics is the public ingress (instead of gcp-proxy).
